name: radcore
description: RadCore - Radboards ERP (leads, sales, inventory, purchasing, accounts, GST)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @radcore/api" "npm run dev -w @radcore/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @radcore/shared && npm run test -w @radcore/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @radcore/shared && npm run typecheck -w @radcore/api && npm run typecheck -w @radcore/web
